purpose: Separate public quick reading from professional evidence without deleting or upgrading any implementation claim.

reader_layers.question: What is the idea, what is protected, and what is still on HOLD?
How does one All-Stop Gate work, and which four external decisions remain closed?

reader_layers.audience: survey, accessibility, operations, safety, cost and independent-review teams
reader_layers.question: Which dimensions, tasks, roles, quantities, gates, evidence fields and exit records must be completed?

visual_text_floors_canvas_px.scope_note: Canvas design pixels at 1600 x 1000; these are composition controls, not a physical print-size or accessibility certification.

artifact_separation.rule: Public figures show one decision per panel. Technical companions retain dimensions, tasks, BOQ, cost, responsibility and acceptance detail.

bilingual_controlled_checkpoints.zh: 京张慢线：让城市跟上最慢的人
bilingual_controlled_checkpoints.en: THE SLOW LINE: Keep pace with the slowest person

bilingual_controlled_checkpoints.zh: 每站必停；人先行，机器让行；AI 退出，服务仍在
bilingual_controlled_checkpoints.en: Serve every stop; people pass first, machines yield; when AI exits, service remains

bilingual_controlled_checkpoints.zh: 无坐标、不可放样、临时候选筛查关系
bilingual_controlled_checkpoints.en: No coordinates, no set-out, provisional candidate-screening relationship

bilingual_controlled_checkpoints.zh: 包内 8/8 PASS；审计与 AI-off 人工等价均为 12/12
bilingual_controlled_checkpoints.en: Package 8/8 PASS; audit and AI-off human equivalence are both 12/12

bilingual_controlled_checkpoints.zh: 4 个外部决策包，4/4 HOLD；保留 12 项现场指标与 12 道外部门
bilingual_controlled_checkpoints.en: Four external decision bundles, 4/4 HOLD; retaining twelve field metrics and twelve external gates

bilingual_controlled_checkpoints.zh: 17 个角色槽位全部未指派
bilingual_controlled_checkpoints.en: All seventeen role slots remain unappointed

bilingual_controlled_checkpoints.zh: 正式总价、报价、资金与恢复储备均为 null/TBC/未锁定
bilingual_controlled_checkpoints.en: Formal total, quotations, funding and restoration reserve remain null/TBC/unfunded

bilingual_controlled_checkpoints.zh: 真实记录、容量、现场核实退出路径与签认尚未形成
bilingual_controlled_checkpoints.en: Actual records, capacity, field-verified egress routes and sign-offs do not yet exist

bilingual_controlled_checkpoints.zh: 任一群体安全关键失败、等价缺失或无法退出，整体 HOLD
bilingual_controlled_checkpoints.en: Any group safety-critical failure, missing equivalent or failed exit keeps the whole unit on HOLD

audit_boundary: This is a participant-controlled source-pair and layout audit. It does not certify independent human translation, WCAG conformance, print accessibility, field performance, permission, appointment or professional sign-off.
